::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Novr 10th 1877  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS University of Delaware
:::

My dear [Mrs Johns](people/person_772.qmd)

So many thanks for your kindness in doing me that nice couvre pied. It was just what [Miss Walter](people/person_1462.qmd) had been assuring me that the sofa specially wanted for the winter and it brightens us up beautifully I am sure it has not been weather for going about this winter or rather autumn 

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** Black-edged paper.
